Since \(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}=\sin 60^\circ\),

\[
E=\frac{\sin80^\circ}{\sin20^\circ}-\frac{\sin60^\circ}{\sin80^\circ}
=\frac{\sin^2 80^\circ-\sin60^\circ\sin20^\circ}{\sin20^\circ\sin80^\circ}.
\]

Now simplify the numerator:

\[
\sin^2 80^\circ=\frac{1+\cos20^\circ}{2},\qquad 
\sin60^\circ\sin20^\circ=\frac{\cos40^\circ-\cos80^\circ}{2}.
\]

So

\[
\sin^2 80^\circ-\sin60^\circ\sin20^\circ
=\frac{1+\cos20^\circ-\cos40^\circ+\cos80^\circ}{2}.
\]

Using \(\cos20^\circ-\cos40^\circ=\cos80^\circ\), this becomes

\[
\frac{1+2\cos80^\circ}{2}
=\frac12+\cos80^\circ.
\]

Also,

\[
2\sin20^\circ\sin80^\circ=\cos60^\circ-\cos100^\circ
=\frac12+\cos80^\circ.
\]

Thus the numerator equals \(2\sin20^\circ\sin80^\circ\), so

\[
E=\frac{2\sin20^\circ\sin80^\circ}{\sin20^\circ\sin80^\circ}=2.
\]

\[
\boxed{2}
\]
